Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Oura's splash - the ring logo holds on black, then a lifestyle photo crossfades in and a light bar sweeps across to reveal the tagline before the brand mark and buttons arrive.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Full-bleed splash: opens black with the thin white "ō" ring mark center; then a lifestyle photo (teal backdrop, a hand wearing the ring) fills the screen; the tagline "Personal insights empower your everyday." sits mid-left, the OURA wordmark appears top-left, and frosted pill buttons rise at the bottom.

## Motion spec
Pattern: photo crossfade with a sweeping mask-bar text reveal.
- The ō mark fades out (300ms) as the photo crossfades in (500ms, ease-in-out) with a slow Ken Burns settle (scale 1.06 -> 1, 2s).
- A white bar sweeps left to right across the tagline line (300ms, ease-in-out), and the tagline text wipes in behind it - the bar is the mask's leading edge, so the words appear exactly where the bar has passed.
- The OURA wordmark fades in top-left (300ms) once the sweep completes.
- The bottom buttons rise (translateY 30 -> 0, spring ~320/20) and frost in (backdrop blur ramps 0 -> full, 300ms) in sequence with 100ms stagger.

## Calibration
- The sweep bar is pure white and tall enough to cover the tagline's cap height; it reads as a scan, not a divider.
- The photo stays dim enough that white text reads at full contrast.

## Reduced motion
Photo fades in; tagline fades in whole (300ms); no sweep or Ken Burns.

## Don't miss
- The bar leads the text by zero pixels - text revealed behind it is visible the instant the bar passes.
- Buttons arrive after copy, never before - the eye goes logo, photo, tagline, actions.
